context.conversationContext:
Zheng: 谢谢！对不起。
Thank you! Sorry.

sources.title: 谢谢 — learning card
sources.excerpt: 谢谢 (xiè xiè) — thank you. Sense: thank you. Assessed skill: recognition.

sources.title: 对不起 — learning card
sources.excerpt: 对不起 (duì bù qǐ) — sorry. Sense: sorry. Assessed skill: recognition.

graph.overview: Recognize 谢谢 as an expression of gratitude. Recognize 对不起 as an expression of apology.

waypoints.objective: Recognize 谢谢 as an expression of gratitude.
waypoints.explanation: 谢谢 is used to express thanks when someone helps you or does something kind for you. It is a standard phrase for showing appreciation in everyday Mandarin.

waypoints.objective: Recognize 对不起 as an expression of apology.
waypoints.explanation: 对不起 is used to express regret or say sorry when you have made a mistake or caused inconvenience. It is the standard phrase for apologizing in everyday Mandarin.

context.proposedDirections:
1. Identify the meaning of 谢谢 in a context where a friend hands you a gift (w1).
2. Identify the meaning of 对不起 in a context where you accidentally bump into someone (w2).
3. Distinguish between the meanings of 谢谢 and 对不起 when presented in a single choice set (w1, w2).
